# Liger Tours Namibia

> Locally owned, NTB registered Namibian tour operator running guided group tours across Namibia, for groups of any size, from two travellers to fifty or more. Every route is built around the traveller's dates and pace.

- URL: https://ligertours.com
- Languages: English (clean URLs), Deutsch (/de), Français (/fr), Afrikaans (/af), Português (/pt)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +264 81 472 2552
- Email: info@ligertoursnamibia.com
- Registration: Namibia Tourism Board (NTB)
- Tour routes start and end in Windhoek; trips run nationwide: desert, coast, canyon and wildlife.
- Pricing: every tour quoted individually in Namibian dollars (N$); full quote usually within one working day.

## Guided tours (private, quoted per group)

- Windhoek, Sossusvlei, Swakopmund, Spitzkoppe and Etosha: the signature route linking dunes, coast, granite peaks and big game. https://ligertours.com/tours/windhoek-sossusvlei-swakopmund-spitzkoppe-etosha
- Sossusvlei and Swakopmund Tour: the two most requested stops in a short itinerary. https://ligertours.com/tours/sossusvlei-and-swakopmund
- Etosha National Park and Waterberg Tour: wildlife focus with a plateau finale. https://ligertours.com/tours/etosha-and-waterberg
- Kalahari, Quiver Tree Forest and Fish River Canyon: southern Namibia at scale. https://ligertours.com/tours/kalahari-quiver-tree-fish-river-canyon
- Swakopmund, Damaraland, Owamboland and Etosha: culture and wildlife. https://ligertours.com/tours/swakopmund-damaraland-owamboland-etosha
- Windhoek, Sossusvlei, Swakopmund and Brandberg: desert and coast loop. https://ligertours.com/tours/windhoek-sossusvlei-swakopmund-brandberg
- 24 Days Namibia Discovery Tour: the full country circuit, unhurried. https://ligertours.com/tours/24-days-namibia-discovery

## Day activities (bookable standalone or added to any tour)

Game drives; Sandwich Harbour 4x4 (where the ocean meets the desert, Walvis Bay); city and township tours; Windhoek by night; traditional cooking class; Bushmen walk; sunrise desert excursion; photography tours; Spitzkoppe hiking; Swakopmund coastal adventure; Etosha wildlife safari; stargazing; Kalahari cultural experience. All: https://ligertours.com/activities

## Answers to common questions

- Large groups: yes, groups of every size including fifty or more; route, pace and vehicles are built around the group.
- Departure: all routes start and end in Windhoek; pick-up details confirmed before travel.
- Cost: quoted individually in N$ by group size, season and accommodation; quote within one working day.
- Best time: May to October (high season); lodges fill months ahead, enquire early.
- Operator: locally owned and registered with the Namibia Tourism Board (NTB).
- Custom routes: built every week; tell the team what you want to see and how long you have.

Enquiries: https://ligertours.com/contact
